title: Thursday Quick Tip
subtitle: The extra gear bag
hook: A player shows up without a glove again.
statement: A spare bag can keep a kid in practice.
q1: Do you carry spare gear for kids who forget —
q2: or let kids sit so they remember next time?
t1: Both can work. But kids stay involved
t2: when one forgotten item does not end their day.
cta: Coaches — do you bring extra gear?
ctaLines: A spare glove. A spare helmet. Extra water.
Bring spares or let them learn?
ctaPrompt: Share your gear habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
A player shows up without a glove again.
They cannot field without one. They sit and watch.
A spare bag can keep a kid in practice.
Bring spares or let them learn. Every team is different.
Do you bring extra gear? Share your habit in the comments.
